versions.content: ImplementationDataType has been introduced to opti- mize the formal support for data type handling on the implementation level The concept of an ImplementationDataType has been introduced to optimize the for- mal support for data type handling on the implementation level. That is, an ImplementationDataType conceptually corresponds to the level of (C) source code. For example, ImplementationDataType s have a direct impact on the contract (please find an explanation of this term in [2]) of a software-component and the RTE.
